commentary: Market breadth at 52 alongside a CAUTION gate reinforces Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil's primary directive: align fully with market direction before committing risk capital. Defying global weakness on heavy institutional flows confirms index resilience, yet neutral breadth signals elevated risk of false breakouts. In this environment, SEPA discipline mandates progressive exposure and strict asymmetry: fund only Stage 2 leaders displaying verified CANSLIM acceleration (EPS >=25% and sales >=15%), while capping decelerating or unverified names at Watch. If market conditions deteriorate, tight stop discipline guarantees capital preservation.
limitations: Daily scan observations are not fills or performance results.
Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Darvas Box Method

360ONE.technical: Clearing its 20-day high on 2.25x volume confirms supply absorption. The stock trades constructively above rising short and long-term averages, with RSI at 59 reflecting orderly Stage 2 accumulation without upside exhaustion.
360ONE.fundamental: Annual recurring revenue AUM expanded 24% YoY, but consolidated Q2 net profit fell 4.9% YoY on higher operating expenses. Tangible ROE remains healthy at 16.9% with low leverage, yet slowing top-line growth fails CANSLIM thresholds.
360ONE.risk: Thesis fails on a close below 1142.82 support; strict 6.6% stop discipline is mandatory as decelerating quarterly earnings increase false-breakout risk.

63MOONS.technical: Forming a multi-month double-bottom base above rising 21-EMA, 50-SMA, and 200-SMA. RSI at 56 and MACD above zero suggest constructive base building, though volume expansion remains muted on the turn.
63MOONS.fundamental: Operating revenue grew 5% YoY in Q1 FY27, but standalone net profit collapsed 82% YoY with negative core operating margins. Despite an almost debt-free balance sheet, erratic earnings and negative ROCE disqualify CANSLIM leadership.
63MOONS.risk: Pattern invalidates on a breakdown below 883.03; tight stop protects against fundamental deterioration pulling the stock back into Stage 4 decline.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Textbook Stage 2 breakout clearing 20-session highs after a constructive bounce off the rising 21-EMA. RSI at 58 provides substantial overhead runway without momentum extension.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Outstanding CANSLIM credentials: consolidated Q2 PAT surged 38% YoY to ₹1,288 crore on 31% revenue growth. Lending AUM rose 32% with improving asset quality metrics, confirming strong institutional sponsorship.
ABCAPITAL.risk: Thesis fails if price drops below 391.17 on heavy volume; strict 6.2% stop limits downside if market caution prompts financial sector weakness.

ABSLNN50ET.technical: Advancing cleanly above all key moving averages with a 20-day high breakout supported by 1.26x volume. RSI at 66 reflects solid relative strength tracking large-cap index breadth.
ABSLNN50ET.fundamental: Passive exchange-traded fund replicating the Nifty Next 50 Index. Corporate financial metrics such as EPS growth, operating margins, ROCE, and debt leverage do not apply to this index vehicle.
ABSLNN50ET.risk: Setup fails on a broad market pullback beneath 76.15 support; disciplined 4.2% stop restricts loss exposure under cautionary gate conditions.

ADANIENSOL.technical: Strong Stage 2 breakout clearing a 20-day consolidation above rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. RSI at 60 and positive MACD confirm institutional demand and powerful upside momentum.
ADANIENSOL.fundamental: Exceptional O'Neil CANSLIM delivery: Q2 PAT jumped 148% YoY to ₹1,364 crore on 53% revenue growth, backed by 68% operating EBITDA expansion. High borrowings of ₹51,520 crore are mitigated by robust infrastructure cash flows.
ADANIENSOL.risk: Pattern fails on a breakdown below the 1575.77 pivot stop; 5.8% stop discipline protects capital from high-beta infrastructure volatility.

ADANIGREEN.technical: Clearing a 20-day high pivot while trading above rising 21-day EMA, 50-day SMA, and 200-day SMA. RSI at 63 and positive MACD show healthy Stage 2 trend momentum.
ADANIGREEN.fundamental: Operational capacity crossed 20.8 GW with revenue up 42% YoY and EBITDA margin at 93%. However, quarterly net profit growth decelerated to 16% YoY due to elevated finance and depreciation costs.
ADANIGREEN.risk: Thesis invalidates below 1326.34; strict stop discipline prevents holding through capital-intensive earnings drag if execution slows.
